title: Refuse tracker writes into a worktree with a live worker turn
body: Outcome: `krn task create|edit|close|dep --worktree <path>` exits 75 when <path> holds a running krn worker session (session.json status running), instead of writing a file the scope check later reports as a worker violation. Evidence: t-n9b3q2g round 3 exit 3 'scope violation: tasks/t-r960z2s.json' (.krn/runs/lead/acceptance-checks/worker-3.txt) after the lead created a task during the turn. Proof: test/tasks/worker-busy.test.ts red at base by assertion.
